title: Project Manager
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  

The Senior Manager, Managed Services Operations is a senior management role, responsible for operating within a Region/Country or Services function and is accountable for service delivery at the highest level thereby ensuring client satisfaction and the successful continuance of business operations within the organization.  

  

The primary objective of this role is to ensure contracted Managed Services outcomes are delivered to the client and assists with the planning, building and supporting of delivering managed services to meet business objectives. **Key responsibilities:*** Proactively monitors and drives service delivery to clients.
* Manages client incidents by investigating and providing solutions that help solve client problems as escalated by team leaders and engineers.
* Works with client delivery teams to evaluate regional client reviews to ensure proactive incident management at client sites.
* Ensures that the standard client information repository related to technology, operations manuals is current and accurate.
* Creates and maintains a comprehensive list of client requirements, the scope of deliverables, technology and the delivery model.
* Runs the managed services operations in alignment with the service management service operations (SMSO) process, delivering promised outcomes to clients.
* Provides operational support and continuous service improvement post client handover from Technical Services (or other) teams.
* Plans and implements training and development initiatives for direct reports.
* Engages with clients for technical operations as part of routine operations.
* Plans and implements key service improvement priorities based on a continual service improvement approach.
* Feeds continual service improvement priorities into the automation team.
* Leads the team in the implementation of strategic initiatives and measures, analyses and improves team’s delivery capabilities.
* Ensures that tracking and monitoring of the performance of service delivery through all channels (human, digital, self\-service, automated) is carried out, metrics and reports are analyzed, and issues are resolved.
* Responsible for the day to day running of the Managed Services Operations team in line with the performance established by the business.
* Ensures maximum uptime and the accurate and early response to client operational issues.
* Responsible for resource planning and work allocation to meet agreed service levels.
* Identifies opportunities for continuous service improvement.
* Engages with clients for technical operations as part of routine operations
 **To thrive in this role, you need to have:*** Excellent organizational and team management skills.
* Excellent communication skills – both verbal and written coupled with excellent ability to collaborate with internal stakeholders and external clients.
* Extended understanding of budgets and cost management.
* Excellent time management, prioritization and delegation abilities.
* Excellent focus on client centricity.
* Highly focused on business outcomes.
* Ability to guide the team through transformational objectives set out by the business.
* Excellent ability to work across different cultures and social groups.
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment and adapt to changing circumstances.
 **Academic qualifications and certifications:*** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent degree in Information Technology or Computing or related field.
* ITIL certification is desirable.
 **Required experience:*** Extended experience in coaching and mentoring engineering team(s) gained within an information technology services organization.
* Extended demonstrated experience implementing continual service improvement initiatives (through automation, process enhancements).
* Extended demonstrated experience in organizational change management (transformational experience).
* Extended demonstrated experience in domain towers such as Network, Collaboration/Customer experience, Cloud, Security, Data Center.
**Workplace type****:**

On\-site Working **About NTT DATA**  

NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune


Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through


responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with


unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and


application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move


confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more


than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as


established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each


year in R\&D.

 **Equal Opportunity Employer**  

NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

**Company Description**  

We’re in tune with what the world is buying. If you can think of it, we’re measuring it. We sift through the small stuff and piece together big pictures to provide a comprehensive understanding of what’s happening now and what’s coming next for our clients. Today’s data is tomorrow’s marketplace revelation.

 **Job Description**  

* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of complex projects, ensuring agreed timelines, budgets, quality standards, and client expectations are consistently met.
* Lead the review of proposals and study designs, independently resolving complex design and execution issues to ensure field specifications are accurate, practical, and commercially viable.
* Take accountability for pricing, cost assumptions, resource requirements, and delivery timelines, balancing competitiveness with operational feasibility, quality, and profitability.
* Partner directly with analysts, account teams, and vendors to clarify objectives, recommend appropriate study designs, and translate requirements into clear, executable project plans.
* Make timely, independent decisions on project priorities, vendors, schedules, costs, and delivery trade\-offs, escalating only matters involving significant commercial, client, or operational risk.
* Serve as the primary point of accountability for assigned projects, establishing clear milestones and ensuring risks, dependencies, decisions, and changes are actively managed and communicated.
* Coordinate cross\-functional stakeholders and influence outcomes, ensuring alignment and removing barriers to successful project delivery.
* Manage multiple priorities across the project, identifying capacity constraints, conflicting requirements, and delivery risks early and agreeing practical solutions with relevant stakeholders.
* Lead fieldwork coordination and vendor management, holding partners accountable for agreed standards of quality, responsiveness, cost, and timeliness.
* Own project financial performance, including budget management, cost control, vendor expenditure, variance analysis, and timely corrective action.

title: Asst Project Manager_DC
description:
**What will you do:**



As a Senior Service Engineer, you will deliver advanced service, commissioning, and troubleshooting expertise for chiller systems in mission\-critical data center environments. You will:


* Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective repairs on Air\-Cooled and Water\-Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
* Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control\-related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.
* Conduct chiller start\-up, commissioning, performance testing, and system optimization.
* Manage site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.
* Support upgrades, retrofits, and energy\-efficiency improvements in existing cooling infrastructure.
* Review technical drawings, wiring diagrams, P\&IDs, submittals, and project documents for accuracy and compliance.
* Maintain detailed service reports, performance logs, and equipment documentation.
* Ensure compliance with safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer\-specific operational protocols.
* Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
* Interface regularly with customers to provide updates, clarify technical issues, and ensure timely project and service completion.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis and implement corrective/preventive actions.
* Collaborate with internal teams including sales, engineering, and project management to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Submit RCA and 8D reports in a timely manner.
* Attend Monthly MOR and Quarterly QBR meetings with data center clients.


**What you will bring: (Skills \& Competencies)**


* Strong expertise in Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, ideally in data center environments.
* Deep understanding of refrigeration cycles, HVAC controls, BMS/EMS integration, and redundancy concepts.
* Proficiency in diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and controls issues using diagnostic tools and software.
* Ability to interpret wiring diagrams, technical drawings, P\&IDs, and OEM manuals.
* Strong communication skills to operate effectively in mission‑critical customer environments.
* Sound knowledge of safety standards and best practices.
* Strong problem\-solving capability and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience supporting mission\-critical data centers or large industrial cooling systems.
* OEM\-specific training or certifications (Trane, Carrier, Daikin) preferred.
* Knowledge of energy\-efficiency programs, retrofits, and performance optimization.
* Project management experience or certification is a plus.


We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

(New York): Your Partner in Bringing Concepts to Life** We are full\-service Visual Merchandising, Retail Display, Signage, Printing and Custom Fabrication company with over 100,000 Sq Ft production facility in New York and more than 100 employees. Established in 2004, the scalable organization delivers exceptional value through in\-house graphic design, expert fabrication, and state\-of\-the\-art machinery, continuously improving processes and using robotic automation to meet urgent deadlines with a wide range of high\-quality visual products and displays.

**Overview:** We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced **Project Coordinator** or a similar role like client servicing etc., who has worked in Retail and Visual Merchandising Environment or Exhibition and Events or similar space, to oversee and manage the projects associated with leading brands. The ideal candidate will ensure timely project completion by coordinating between internal teams and external vendors. The role involves end\-to\-end project management, fabrication, Installation and logistics for delivering excellence in a fast\-paced and creative environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Project Planning and Management**: Develop project plans, set timelines, and allocate resources effectively to meet client objectives and deadlines.
* **Data \& Records Maintenance:** Demonstrated computer proficiency with a proven track record of managing project documentation, creating project timelines and maintaining and fulfilling them and maintaining clear project communications.
* **Vendor Coordination**: Identify and onboard external vendors, negotiate and ensure their work aligns with project requirements.
* **Team Collaboration**: Act as the primary point of contact between design teams, production units and clients, ensuring smooth communication and operations.
* **Budget Management**: Monitor project budgets, control costs, and ensure profitability without compromising quality.
* **Installation Management**: Build and maintain strong relationships with internal team and external install team, ensuring timely installs and competitive pricing.
* **Compliance**: Ensure all projects meet industry standards, local regulations, and safety guidelines.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* 3\+ years of experience in Project Management / Coordination, outsourcing and vendor management specific to the Retail Displays and Visual Merchandising industry.
* **Bachelor’s degree – (preferably Mechanical Engineering)**

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Sr. Technical Program Manager
About the role:  

We are looking for experienced technical program management professionals to join our STRM\-Security Threat and Response Management team who is responsible for identifying and implementing new tools and capabilities to secure our assets.
  

  

The Senior Technical Program Manager (Sr. TPM) is responsible for leading complex, cross‑functional technical programs that deliver critical business outcomes. This role drives end‑to‑end execution across multiple engineering, product, and business teams, ensuring alignment to strategic priorities, disciplined delivery, and measurable impact.
  

  

The ideal candidate brings strong technical depth, seasoned program leadership, and the ability to influence at all levels. They translate ambiguous business objectives into clear execution plans, proactively manage risks and dependencies, and ensure predictable, high‑quality delivery across large‑scale initiatives.  

  

Responsibilities:  

* Lead and successfully deliver multiple concurrent, complex, and cross functional technical programs from concept through launch, ensuring alignment to business and security objectives
* Act as a strategic partner to Engineering, Product, Security, Architecture, and Business stakeholders to drive shared outcomes
* Own end to end program planning and execution, including scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and delivery commitments
* Define and track clear milestones, success metrics, and program health indicators to ensure predictable delivery
* Drive execution rigor by managing dependencies, facilitating deep technical discussions, aligning on architecture decisions, and navigating engineering trade offs
* Proactively identify execution risks, surface trade offs, and drive timely risk mitigation and decision making
* Provide clear, concise, executive level status updates, metrics, and data driven recommendations to leadership
* Establish and continuously improve program governance, delivery processes, and operational excellence best practices
* Serve as a strong voice for the team—leading demos, acceptance discussions, and representing the program with confidence across forums as needed
* Mentor and guide junior TPMs and less experienced team members, fostering growth, accountability, and high standards of execution

  

All About You:
  

* Proven ability to operate in ambiguous, fast‑paced environments
* Exceptional stakeholder communication and influencing skills
* Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and delivery excellence
* Strong understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and agile delivery in complex, multi‑team environments.
* Proven ability to break down ambiguous problems, plan and execute work through Agile delivery models (Scrum, Kanban), and consistently deliver high impact technical programs.
* Comfortable diving deep into technical details to inform trade offs, manage risk, and build credibility with engineering teams.
* Demonstrates data driven decision making and leads continuous improvement across teams and programs.
* Effectively partners with business leaders, architects, engineers, and designers to shape delivery strategy and execution plans.
* Builds strong relationships and influences without authority, earning trust and respect across dependent teams.
* Exhibits strong technical writing, documentation, and knowledge transfer skills, enabling teams beyond immediate scope to operate independently.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Program Manager - IFS Loops
description:
**Company Description**  

IFS is a billion\-dollar revenue company with 7000\+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award\-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting\-edge.


At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.


We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.


By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a **global, diverse environment;** you will be joining a **winning team** with a **commitment to sustainability;** and a company where we get things done so that you can **make a positive impact** on the world.


We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **\#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI\-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.


If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

 **Job Description**  

IFS Loops is revolutionizing how leaders and teams work with our agentic platform, driving  

unprecedented efficiency and scale. We’re establishing a new Program Management team and  

are looking for a Program Manager to join us in India, working with EST and UK time zones. This  

role is crucial for managing and delivering complex, high\-impact projects for our largest  

enterprise customers. You will work closely with clients, internal teams, and senior leadership to  

ensure successful project execution and long\-term business value.

**Key Responsibility**


As a Program Manager, you will be a key member of a newly formed team, responsible for  

delivering our most high\-profile customer engagements. This means you’ll be:

  

* Program Management: Leading and managing multiple enterprise\-level projects from initiation through delivery, optimization, and tuning.
* You’ll ensure projects are completed on time, within scope, and on budget, adhering to our Services Methodology approach.
* Customer Engagement: Building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders, including senior leaders and project managers.
* You’ll serve as the primary point of contact for project\-related activities and help educate clients on the nuances of AI and AI assistants.
* **Workshop Ownership and Execution**: Taking ownership of developing workshops to support the creation of user stories and technical requirements for our customers’ AI assistants.
* **Operations**: Managing dependencies and resources, initiating change orders, and documenting all key decisions and meeting outcomes. You’ll also support the sales process as needed to instill customer confidence.
* **Team Leadership**: Coordinating services team members—including solution architects, implementation specialists, and integration engineers—to ensure cohesive project execution. You’ll also collaborate with product, customer success, and sales teams.
* **Risk Management**: Identifying potential project risks and proactively developing mitigation strategies. You’ll serve as the primary escalation point for issues that could jeopardize customer satisfaction or project completion.
* **Steering Committee Ownership**: Providing regular project updates to key senior stakeholders at both TheLoops and the customer’s organization
* **Performance Monitoring**: Tracking project performance in real time, analyzing key metrics, and preparing detailed status reports and dashboards for clients and internal teams. metrics, and preparing detailed status reports and dashboards for clients and internal teams.
* **Continuous Improvement**: Implementing best practices and lessons learned to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of project delivery and advancing operational prowess through collaboration with Services leadership.
* **Customer Success**: Working closely with Sales and Customer Success to ensure a seamless handover and continued client satisfaction post\-implementation, as well as executing follow\-on projects to grow customer value

  

**Qualifications**  

* You have 7\+ years of experience in program or project management, with a focus on enterprise clients within the technology or SaaS industry.
* You have a strong understanding of AI technologies, particularly in deploying conversational AI and automation solutions for large enterprises.
* You can communicate the nuances of AI to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* You have a deep understanding of consumer customer service best practices and strategies.
* You are technically adept and comfortable with APIs, data migration, and configuring complex software integrations.
* You’re passionate about AI and possess a working understanding of concepts like LLMs, embeddings, prompt engineering, and vector databases.
* You have a bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related field; a PMP or similar certification is highly desirable.
* You have proven experience building project delivery methodologies and processes.
* You’re a natural leader with excellent communication skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* You’re willing to travel up to 20% of the time

**What Success Looks Like in 3–6 Months**

  

Within your first 3\-6 months, you will have successfully demonstrated your impact by:

* **Becoming an Expert**: You’ll be proficient with TheLoops’s platform and will have a deep understanding of the common challenges our customers face.
* **Leading Implementations**: You will have autonomously managed and completed at least one high\-stakes customer implementation from start to finish. This includes leading discovery, architecting the solution, configuring the platform, and successfully migrating data.
* **Driving Customer Value**: You will have received positive feedback from customers, validating that you’ve not only met their technical requirements but have also empowered their teams and improved their operational efficiency.
* **Strengthening Team Collaboration**: You will have established strong working relationships with the sales, engineering, and product teams, providing valuable feedback from the field to help improve our product and processes.


Why Join Us

* Work on cutting\-edge AI solutions that have real business impact
* Be part of a fast\-growing team shaping how enterprises deploy AI at scale
* High ownership, high visibility, and a chance to lead transformational projects
* Competitive compensation, flexible work, and the support of a global enterprise (IFS)

  

**Additional Information** *We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

title: Project Manager - Facilities
